title: Health
description: Say what is wrong and understand the advice.

questions.sentence: Tame kem cho?
options: Hu majama nathi.
Hu majama chu.
Hu ghare chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu majama nathi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am not well.

questions.sentence: Tamne shu thay che?
options: Mane mathu dukhe che.
Mane bhookh lage che.
Mane ungh ave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane mathu dukhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: I have a headache.

questions.sentence: Mane pet ma dukhe che.
options: My stomach hurts.
My head hurts.
My leg hurts.
questions.correctAnswer: My stomach hurts.

questions.sentence: Tamne mathu dukhe che?
options: Ha, savar thi dukhe che.
Na, mane bhookh lagi che.
Ha, hu ghare jau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, savar thi dukhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it has been hurting since morning.

questions.sentence: Hu aaje majama nathi.
options: I am not well today.
I am fine today.
I am at home today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not well today.

questions.sentence: Mara pag ma dukhe che.
options: My leg hurts.
My hand hurts.
My back hurts.
questions.correctAnswer: My leg hurts.

questions.sentence: Tu majama che?
options: Na, mane taav che.
Ha, hu doctor pase chu.
Na, hu ghare chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mane taav che.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I have a fever.

questions.sentence: Mane thodu dukhe che.
options: It hurts a little.
It hurts a lot.
It does not hurt.
questions.correctAnswer: It hurts a little.

questions.sentence: Ketla divas thi dukhe che?
options: Be divas thi dukhe che.
Aa hath ma dukhe che.
Mane atyare saru che.
questions.correctAnswer: Be divas thi dukhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: It has been hurting for two days.

questions.sentence: Tamne galu dukhe che ke dant?
options: Galu dukhe che, dant nathi dukhta.
Mane pag ma vagyu che.
Mane be divas thi taav che.
questions.correctAnswer: Galu dukhe che, dant nathi dukhta.
questions.translatedSentence: My throat hurts, my teeth do not.

questions.sentence: Tamari kai aankh ma dukhe che?
options: Jamni aankh ma dukhe che.
Dabo hath savar thi dukhe che.
Mara kaan ma avaj ave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Jamni aankh ma dukhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: My right eye hurts.

questions.sentence: Mara daba hath ma dukhe che.
options: My left hand hurts.
My right hand hurts.
My left leg hurts.
questions.correctAnswer: My left hand hurts.

questions.sentence: Tamne peeth ma dukhe che?
options: Ha, besva thi vadhare dukhe che.
Na, mane bhookh lagi che.
Ha, mara kaan ma dukhe che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, besva thi vadhare dukhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it hurts more when I sit.

questions.sentence: Mara bane pag savar thi dukhe che.
options: Both my legs have been hurting since morning.
Both my hands have been hurting since morning.
My legs start hurting in the evening.
questions.correctAnswer: Both my legs have been hurting since morning.

questions.sentence: Tamne kya vagyu che?
options: Mara daba ghuntan ma vagyu che.
Mane raat e ungh nathi avti.
Mane thodo taav lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mara daba ghuntan ma vagyu che.
questions.translatedSentence: I have hurt my left knee.

questions.sentence: Mari aangli ma vagyu che, pan lohi nathi nikaltu.
options: My finger is hurt, but it is not bleeding.
My finger is hurt and it is bleeding a lot.
My hand is hurt, but it does not hurt much.
questions.correctAnswer: My finger is hurt, but it is not bleeding.

questions.sentence: Tamaru mathu haju pan dukhe che?
options: Na, have saru lage che.
Ha, mane bhookh lagi che.
Na, mane pag ma vagyu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, have saru lage che.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I feel better now.

questions.sentence: Mane kaan ma thodo dukhavo thay che.
options: I have a slight pain in my ear.
I have a slight pain in my eye.
I have a bad pain in my ear.
questions.correctAnswer: I have a slight pain in my ear.

questions.sentence: Bolo, tamne shu taklif che?
options: Mane tran divas thi taav che.
Mane aa dava thi saru thai gayu che.
Doctor sahebe mane kale tapasyo hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane tran divas thi taav che.
questions.translatedSentence: I have had a fever for three days.

questions.sentence: Mane raat e vadhare taav ave che.
options: My fever goes up at night.
My fever comes down at night.
I get a fever every morning.
questions.correctAnswer: My fever goes up at night.

questions.sentence: Tamne ulti jevu thay che?
options: Ha, jamya pachhi thay che.
Na, mane bhookh khoob lage che.
Ha, mane ghuntan ma vagyu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, jamya pachhi thay che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it happens after I eat.

questions.sentence: Tame koi dava lidhi che?
options: Ha, me kale taav ni goli lidhi hati.
Na, mane doctor pase javu nathi gamtu.
Ha, mane savar thi chakkar ave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, me kale taav ni goli lidhi hati.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I took a fever tablet yesterday.

questions.sentence: Hu ubho thau tyare mane chakkar ave che.
options: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
I feel dizzy when I lie down.
I feel tired when I walk.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel dizzy when I stand up.

questions.sentence: Tamne bhookh lage che ke nahi?
options: Na, be divas thi bhookh lagti nathi.
Ha, mane gala ma dukhe che.
Na, mane raat e sari ungh ave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, be divas thi bhookh lagti nathi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I have not felt hungry for two days.

questions.sentence: Mane pehla kyarey aavu thayu nathi.
options: This has never happened to me before.
This happens to me every month.
This happened to me last year as well.
questions.correctAnswer: This has never happened to me before.

questions.sentence: Tamne kai dava thi allergy che?
options: Ha, ek dava thi mari chamdi par chakama thay che.
Na, hu Surat thi avu chu.
Ha, mane roj savare mathu dukhe che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ek dava thi mari chamdi par chakama thay che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, one medicine gives me a rash on my skin.

questions.sentence: Mane khavama kai svaad lagto nathi.
options: Food does not taste of anything to me.
I do not feel like eating anything.
I cannot smell anything at all.
questions.correctAnswer: Food does not taste of anything to me.

questions.sentence: Bolo saheb, tamne shu joie che?
options: Mane taav ni goli joie che.
Mane doctor pase javu che.
Mane aa medical store gamyu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane taav ni goli joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: I need a tablet for fever.

questions.sentence: Aa goli divas ma tran vaar lejo.
options: Take this tablet three times a day.
Take this tablet twice a day.
Take this tablet for three days.
questions.correctAnswer: Take this tablet three times a day.

questions.sentence: Aa dava jamya pehla levani ke pachhi?
options: Jamya pachhi levani che.
Divas ma be vaar levani che.
Aa dava raat e levani che.
questions.correctAnswer: Jamya pachhi levani che.
questions.translatedSentence: It has to be taken after eating.

questions.sentence: Tamari pase doctor ni chithhi che?
options: Ha, aa rahi chithhi.
Na, mane aa dava nathi joiti.
Ha, mane tran divas thi shardi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, aa rahi chithhi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, here is the prescription.

questions.sentence: Aa syrup ni be chamchi savare ane be raat e lo.
options: Take two spoons of this syrup in the morning and two at night.
Take one spoon of this syrup in the morning and one at night.
Take two spoons of this syrup only at night.
questions.correctAnswer: Take two spoons of this syrup in the morning and two at night.

questions.sentence: Aa dava na ketla thaya?
options: Ek so vees rupiya thaya.
Tran divas chale etli che.
Divas ma be goli levani che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek so vees rupiya thaya.
questions.translatedSentence: It comes to one hundred and twenty rupees.

questions.sentence: Aa dava khali pete na levay.
options: This medicine must not be taken on an empty stomach.
This medicine must be taken on an empty stomach.
This medicine must not be taken at night.
questions.correctAnswer: This medicine must not be taken on an empty stomach.

questions.sentence: Goli lidha pachhi ungh ave to shu karvu?
options: To gadi na chalavso.
To bija medical store ma juo.
To vadhare ek goli lai lejo.
questions.correctAnswer: To gadi na chalavso.
questions.translatedSentence: Then do not drive.

questions.sentence: Jo taav be divas ma na utre to pacha avjo.
options: If the fever does not come down in two days, come back.
If the fever comes down in two days, come back.
Come back in two days for a different medicine.
questions.correctAnswer: If the fever does not come down in two days, come back.

questions.sentence: Tamne shardi kyare thai?
options: Kal raat thi naak vahe che.
Mane pet ma bahu dukhe che.
Hu roj be goli lau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Kal raat thi naak vahe che.
questions.translatedSentence: My nose has been running since last night.

questions.sentence: Mane sukhi udharas che ane raat e vadhi jay che.
options: I have a dry cough and it gets worse at night.
I have a chesty cough and it gets worse at night.
I have a dry cough and it settles down at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I have a dry cough and it gets worse at night.

questions.sentence: Atyare taav ketlo che?
options: Ek so tran degree che.
Be divas thi che.
Mane khoob thandi lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek so tran degree che.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a hundred and three degrees.

questions.sentence: Tu patang chagavta chhat par thi padi gayo?
options: Ha, mara ghuntan ma vagyu che.
Na, mane shardi thai gai che.
Ha, mane patang chagavvanu bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mara ghuntan ma vagyu che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, and I hurt my knee.

questions.sentence: Kale hu Sabarmati na kinare padi gayo ane mara hath ma thi lohi nikalyu.
options: Yesterday I fell on the Sabarmati riverfront and my hand bled.
Yesterday I fell on the Sabarmati riverfront, but my hand did not bleed.
Yesterday I fell at home and my hand bled.
questions.correctAnswer: Yesterday I fell on the Sabarmati riverfront and my hand bled.

questions.sentence: Taav sathe thandi pan lage che?
options: Ha, odhya pachhi pan thandi lage che.
Na, mane pag ma vagyu che.
Ha, mane khoob bhookh lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, odhya pachhi pan thandi lage che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I feel cold even under a blanket.

questions.sentence: Taav ma thepla ke bhare khavanu na khaso.
options: Do not eat thepla or heavy food while you have a fever.
Eat thepla and other heavy food while you have a fever.
Do not drink cold water while you have a fever.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not eat thepla or heavy food while you have a fever.

questions.sentence: Ghav par shu lagavu?
options: Pehla paani thi dhoi ne malam lagavo.
Pehla garam chaas pi lo.
Pehla taav ni be goli lai lo.
questions.correctAnswer: Pehla paani thi dhoi ne malam lagavo.
questions.translatedSentence: First wash it with water and then put the ointment on.

questions.sentence: Mane etli udharas che ke raat e ungh nathi avti.
options: My cough is so bad that I cannot sleep at night.
My cough is so bad that I cannot eat at night.
I cough a little at night, but I sleep well.
questions.correctAnswer: My cough is so bad that I cannot sleep at night.

questions.sentence: Doctor saheb, hu kyare thi kaam par jai shaku?
options: Be divas aaram karo, pachhi jai shakso.
Tame atyare j medical store par jai shako cho.
Mane puchhya vagar tame dava badli nakhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Be divas aaram karo, pachhi jai shakso.
questions.translatedSentence: Rest for two days, and then you can go.

questions.sentence: Divas ma ochha ma ochhu ath glass paani pijo.
options: Drink at least eight glasses of water a day.
Drink no more than eight glasses of water a day.
Drink eight glasses of hot water every night.
questions.correctAnswer: Drink at least eight glasses of water a day.

questions.sentence: Taav utri gayo che, pan mane haju nabalai lage che.
options: Thoda divas halku khao ane vadhare aaram karo.
Have tame roj savare daudva jai shako cho.
To dava band kari do ane kaam shuru kari do.
questions.correctAnswer: Thoda divas halku khao ane vadhare aaram karo.
questions.translatedSentence: Eat light for a few days and rest more.

questions.sentence: Jo tame barabar dava lesho to ek athvadiya ma saara thai jasho.
options: If you take the medicine properly, you will be well in a week.
If you take the medicine properly, you will be well in a month.
Even if you take the medicine, it will take a month to get well.
questions.correctAnswer: If you take the medicine properly, you will be well in a week.

questions.sentence: Have tamne kem lage che?
options: Pehla karta ghanu saru lage che, aabhar.
Mane haju sudhi dava mali nathi.
Mane kale thi navo taav shuru thayo che.
questions.correctAnswer: Pehla karta ghanu saru lage che, aabhar.
questions.translatedSentence: I feel much better than before, thank you.

questions.sentence: Undhiyu bhare hoy che etle atyare na khaso, chaas pijo.
options: Undhiyu is heavy, so do not eat it now; drink buttermilk instead.
Undhiyu is light, so you can eat it now with buttermilk.
Do not drink buttermilk now, but you may eat undhiyu.
questions.correctAnswer: Undhiyu is heavy, so do not eat it now; drink buttermilk instead.

questions.sentence: Doctor sahebe tamne shu kahyu?
options: Emne kahyu ke ek athvadiyu aaram karvo joie.
Emne kahyu ke hu Vadodara ma rahu chu.
Emne mane koi dava lakhi aapi nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Emne kahyu ke ek athvadiyu aaram karvo joie.
questions.translatedSentence: He said that I should rest for a week.

questions.sentence: Hu haju puri rite saro nathi thayo, pan pehla karta saru che.
options: I am not fully better yet, but I am better than before.
I am completely better now, much better than before.
I am not better yet and I feel worse than before.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not fully better yet, but I am better than before.

questions.sentence: Kale thi hu chalva jau to chale?
options: Ha, pan dhime dhime chalajo ane thaki jao to besi jajo.
Na, tame have kyarey chalva na jaso.
Ha, tame kale thi roj be kalak daudi shako cho.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan dhime dhime chalajo ane thaki jao to besi jajo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but walk slowly and sit down if you get tired.
